title: Image en gebruik van kernenergie voor de opwekking van electriciteit 1973
authors: NSS nv v/h Nederlandse stichting voor de statistiek * Den Haag (primary investigator)
descriptions: Indispensability of nuclear power plants to meet the demand for electricity in the long run / risks to be expected for the health of people living close by nuclear power plant / guarantees for the building of safe nuclear power plants / individual anxiety with respect to increase in number of nuclear power plants. Background variables: basic characteristics/ income/capital assets/ education
